subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 22nd day of Planting, 579.
source_quote: Planting 22, 579

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 23rd day of Planting, 579.
source_quote: Planting 23, 579

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: animated broccoli pursuit
fact: A broccoli, animated and moving with unnatural speed, fled toward the apothecary with magical potions and stuff.
source_quote: the broccoli was my best bet. It took off like a shot towards the apothecary, that place with all the magical potions and stuff.

subject: animated potato ambush
fact: Three animated potatoes, one of which was stabbed and the others stunned, were captured and later consumed in a honey-glazed forest stew.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes,” I shout to Seqoia and run after them. The potatoes stare at me as if taunting me. I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry. So I take my knife and stab the one in my hand. The other two potatoes are stunned.

subject: Black Earth Cult encampment
fact: A well-hidden encampment built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills, guarded by stone-studded leather armor and stone weapons, houses a temple and stolen honey barrels.
source_quote: It’s built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills. There is a guarded gate with makeshift stone barricades. The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons. Inside the walls is a temple to some god, a weird stone statue, as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: battle site of the caravan ambush
fact: A site littered with overturned wagons, broken barrels, and scattered honey jars, with churned ground and faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks, indicates magical combat by cultists, not bandits.
source_quote: The site is littered with overturned wagons, broken barrels, and scattered honey jars. The ground is churned up. ... I point at faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks. Zinnia looks at me, and I nod, “This is not bandits. This must be the cultists we are looking for.”

subject: stone golem summoning
fact: Thalsor, a druid of the Black Earth Temple, summoned a stone golem resistant to non-magical attacks during combat, which stood despite holy damage.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: mud men appearance
fact: Two mud men appeared beside Calmer during combat, summoned by Thalsor’s incantation, causing chaotic battlefield effects.
source_quote: Suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men. Not something you see every day.

subject: stone storm conjuration
fact: Thalsor conjured a hail of sharp stones during combat, forcing the party to dodge repeatedly while sustaining minor injuries.
source_quote: He conjures up a storm of sharp stones. I manage to dodge most of it, but it still stings like hell.

subject: Kron Hills trail
fact: A trail leading into the Kron Hills, easily followed but nearly blocked by falling rocks suspected to be magically directed, ends at the hidden cult encampment.
source_quote: The trail into the Kron Hills is easy to follow. Although along the way, we almost get crushed by falling rocks. I am worried that the stones were not an accident, but we find nothing.

subject: Thalsor’s druidic rant
fact: Thalsor, a druid of the Black Earth Temple, denounced the party as witless insects and proclaimed the honey as tribute to the Earth Mother, invoking sacred ground and stone wisdom.
source_quote: You think yourselves heroes? … The very stones you trample upon are older, stronger, and far wiser than any of you could ever hope to be. … That honey now belongs to the Black Earth Temple, a tribute to her enduring might.

subject: cultist identification
fact: Cultists wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons were identified as the perpetrators of the caravan ambush and guardians of the stolen honey.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons. … I whisper, “These are the guys.”

subject: Black Earth chant revelation
fact: Surviving guards reported that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone, linking the assault to the cult.
source_quote: The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone.

subject: honey theft motive
fact: The stolen honey was claimed by the Black Earth Temple as tribute to the Earth Mother, not mere plunder.
source_quote: That honey now belongs to the Black Earth Temple, a tribute to her enduring might.

subject: cultist negotiation attempt
fact: Thalsor attempted to negotiate during combat, offering trade in exchange for the honey, but refused to surrender it.
source_quote: Then, Thalsor he brings out something else. … Weird guy. Offers to trade, anything but giving up the honey.

subject: stone runes activation
fact: Faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks at the caravan ambush site flared with ominous light during Thalsor’s incantation, confirming magical cultist involvement.
source_quote: I point at faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks. Zinnia looks at me, and I nod, “This is not bandits. This must be the cultists we are looking for.”

subject: calmer’s failed bluff
fact: Calmer attempted to bluff the cultists by claiming to be lost, but the druid Thalsor immediately recognized them as intruders and denounced their presence.
source_quote: Calmer tries to bluff these bandits–or whatever they are–about being lost, but it’s backfiring something fierce. … He’s not buying what Calmer’s selling.

subject: rogue advantage in combat
fact: The rogue gained advantage in combat due to training, allowing a flanking strike behind Sequoia during the assault on the cultists.
source_quote: I get an advantage because of my rogue training, and I come in right behind Sequoia.

subject: mud man explosion effect
fact: When the mud men were defeated, they exploded, creating area-denial effects that hindered movement and required evasion.
source_quote: When these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move. I’m quick enough to dodge the worst of it, but still, it’s a nasty trick.

subject: Black Earth Temple interior
fact: The interior of the Black Earth Temple contains a weird stone statue and the stolen honey barrels, confirming its role as the cult’s stronghold.
source_quote: Inside the walls is a temple to some god, a weird stone statue, as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: cultist retreat confirmation
fact: All surviving guards who witnessed the attack have since left the town, preventing direct interrogation.
source_quote: they have all since left our town.

subject: Lareth’s target identification
fact: The Black Earth Cult is identified as the target Lareth wants killed, likely due to their possession of a box he seeks.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: Zinnia’s hidden pleasure
fact: Zinnia, though inscrutable, revealed a momentary flash of pleasure upon learning of the cult’s involvement in the honey theft.
source_quote: I look at Zinnia, and although he is inscrutable, even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.

subject: Palsmarie Clee’s silent presence
fact: Palsmarie Clee, the beekeeper druid of Sheernobb, entered the Inn silently, her presence unnoticed until she coughed.
source_quote: As I put the last bit of food in my mouth, Palsmarie Clee coughs. The beekeeper druid of Sheernobb is very quiet. Has she walked into the Inn, or was she always there?

subject: caravan ambush cause
fact: The caravan ambush was not caused by bandits, but by magical cultists wielding stone weapons and chanting ‘Black Earth,’ as confirmed by surviving guards and magical residue.
source_quote: The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone. … Calmer shouts, “Magic was used here, or something very big. This isn’t just a bunch of brigands.”

subject: broccoli as animated object
fact: A broccoli, previously considered mundane, was revealed as an animated object capable of independent movement and direction toward the apothecary.
source_quote: I figured the broccoli was my best bet. It took off like a shot towards the apothecary, that place with all the magical potions and stuff. Honestly, I wasn't quite sure what to do. Part of me thought, "Let it go, it's just a broccoli."

subject: stone golem vulnerability
fact: The stone golem summoned by Thalsor was resistant to all non-magical attacks, requiring holy or arcane damage to defeat.
source_quote: Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: Thalsor’s stone staff
fact: Thalsor wielded a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals, which amplified his magic and caused runes on the walls to flare during his incantations.
source_quote: his hands tightening around a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals. … the runes on the walls flare with an ominous light.

subject: cultist armor description
fact: The cultists wore stone-studded leather armor and carried stone weapons, indicating ritualistic devotion to earth and stone.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: final battle outcome
fact: The party engaged in a chaotic, multi-phase battle against Thalsor, his mud men, the stone golem, and cultist minions, ultimately surviving but not yet defeating the cultists.
source_quote: Things are far from over.

subject: honey-glazed forest stew
fact: A honey-glazed forest stew, consumed after the potato ambush, was described as a blessing and a satisfying meal.
source_quote: And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed. The honey-glazed forest stew feels like a blessing indeed.

subject: potato consumption
fact: One animated potato was killed, captured, and eaten in a stew, with the eater declaring it more filling than a captured rat.
source_quote: And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly. … “You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison.”

source_quote: they have all since left our town.
